subject: Moderated mediation with multiple moderators and latent variables

messages.author: f261e8fba39d2b4b
messages.subject: Moderated mediation with multiple moderators and latent variables
parts:
I am quite new to Lavaan and SEM, but have some experience with R. I am trying to use SEM through lavaan to solve my moderated mediation model. I found this example online and tried to extend/adjust it to fit what I needed: https://ademos.people.uic.edu/Chapter15.html#5_moderated_mediation_analyses_using_%E2%80%9Clavaan%E2%80%9D_package

When I try to fit this model I get the following error: lavaan WARNING: the optimizer warns that a solution has NOT been found! 

I am unsure as to why I get this error and how to solve this. Any help or guidance would be very much appreciated! 

Mod.med <- '#latent variables
cred_BI =~ X1+ X2+ X3+ X4
com_BI =~ X5+ X6 + X7 + X8 + X9 + X10 + X11 + X12 

cred_DI =~ X13 + X14
com_DI =~ X15 + X16

#regressions 
#mediator
#C1-C9 are control variables
QP ~ a1*cred_BI + a2*com_BI + a3*cred_DI + a4*com_DI + a5*cred_BI:cred_DI +a6*com_BI:com_DI + a7*C1 + a8*C2+ a9*C3+ a10*C4+ a11*C5+ a12*C6+ a13*C7+ a14*C8+ a15*C9

#dependent variable
S ~ cdash1*cred_BI + cdash2*com_BI + b1*QP + cdash3*C1 + cdash4*C2+ cdash5*C3 + cdash6*C4+ cdash7*C5+ cdash8*C6+ cdash9*C7+ cdash10*C8+ cdash12*C9

#mean of centered moderators (for use in simple slopes)
com_DI ~ com_DI_mean*1
cred_DI ~ cred_DI_mean*1

#variance of centered moderators (for use in simple slopes)
com_DI ~~ com_DI_var*com_DI
cred_DI ~~ cred_DI_var*cred_DI

#indirect effects conditional on moderator 
Indirect.SDbelow := (a1 + a2 + a5*(cred_DI_mean-sqrt(cred_DI_var)) + a6*(com_DI_mean-sqrt(com_DI_var)))*b1
Indirect.SDabove := (a1 + a2 + a5*(cred_DI_mean+sqrt(cred_DI_var)) + a6*(com_DI_mean+sqrt(com_DI_var)))*b1

#direct effects
Direct := cdash1 + cdash2

#total effects conditional on moderator
Total.SDbelow := Direct + Indirect.SDbelow
Total.SDabove := Direct + Indirect.SDabove

#proportion mediated conditional on moderator
prop.mediated.SDbelow := Indirect.SDbelow / Total.SDbelow
prop.mediated.SDabove := Indirect.SDabove / Total.SDabove

#index of moderated mediation
index1.mod.med := a5*b1
index2.mod.med := a6*b1
'

#FIT MODEL 
mod.med.SEM <- sem(model = Mod.med, data = data, se = "bootstrap", bootstrap = 1000) 

Thank you so much in advance for taking the time to look at my model! 

Marie
